subject: CGN-LOS shipment, not a known consignor
body:
Dear team,

please quote 3 bales of technical textiles from Cologne (CGN) to Lagos (LOS), 410 kg, 1.9 cbm, ready 26.11., we deliver to CGN. Cheapest option, EUR.

We are not a known consignor, so the cargo will need security screening (X-ray) before departure. Please include that in the all-in price.

Best regards
Ayse Demir
Logistics
Lahn Textil GmbH
